<section class="page" id="p3"><div class="wrap"><div class="kicker">A note from my heart</div><h2>My Dear LL… 🤍</h2><div class="card note">My Dear LL, the most precious gift I have got in my entire life a friend like you, my bestestestestest Friend, my home, my comfort zone, my safe place, my secret notebook, my everyting...❤️🧿 I think I would never find myself without you...
